summary: All14native portraits viewed. No broad facial collapse, but no supervised image clearly meets the clean photographic clerical-collar gate; b2-051 is only partial/ambiguous. Four edited holdouts and four fixed unseen portraits show no convincing new clerical collars. Neck artifacts remain serious quality failures.
limits: Small fixed panel. Contact-level coherence does not establish native photographic quality, identity preservation or distributional diversity. Held-out cases remain excluded from training.
